name: Shishir Sharma Upadhyay
tagline: Manual, automation, API and backend testing, backed by hands-on full-stack development.
summary: QA Engineer with expertise in manual, automation, API and backend testing, working with Selenium, TestNG, Postman, JMeter and Burp Suite. Knowledge of the MERN stack gives me a full-stack understanding, so I can follow a defect from the screen, through the API, down to the data.
about: I am a Software QA Engineer based in Lalitpur, Nepal. Day to day I test web and mobile applications: functional, regression, smoke, UI/UX and backend testing across multiple modules, working with developers and business analysts in Agile/Scrum teams.

Outside of work I build full-stack applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. Building the software I test helps me ask better questions about requirements, validation, error handling and data integrity.

focus.title: Test design
focus.text: Scenarios, test cases and test data written from business and functional requirements, covering positive, negative and edge cases, with regression selection and reproducible defect reports.

focus.title: API and data checks
focus.text: REST API testing with Postman (headers, authorization, status codes, response bodies, scripts and request chaining) and SQL queries to validate backend data.

focus.title: Automation
focus.text: Selenium with Java, Maven and TestNG, and Cypress with TypeScript for registration workflows using page objects, dynamic test data, API-assisted flows and Mochawesome reports with screenshots and video.

experience.title: QA Associate
points: Manual testing of web and mobile applications: functional, regression, smoke, UI/UX and backend testing across multiple modules.
Designed and executed detailed test cases, test scenarios and test data based on business and functional requirements.
API testing with Postman and backend data validation with SQL queries to confirm data integrity and accurate system behaviour.
Identified, documented, tracked and retested defects, collaborating closely with developers and business analysts in Agile/Scrum environments.
Tested critical workflows such as authentication, Forgot Password with OTP verification, enrollment, billing, payment processing and policy management.
Hands-on with automation and testing tools including Selenium, TestNG, Apache Maven, Burp Suite and Apache JMeter.

experience.title: QA Intern
points: Gained hands-on experience in manual, automation and API testing.
Created and executed test scenarios, test cases and reports.
Performed frontend, backend, and performance and security testing.
